# Marketing by Committee

> Marketing by Committee is a fractional marketing practice and boutique agency based in Edmonton, Alberta, working with energy, construction, and transportation companies, as well as small businesses across the Greater Edmonton Area.

- Canonical URL: https://www.marketingbycommittee.com/
- Founder: Gurshan Dhillon, Fractional CMO. Former Chief Marketing Officer of a major Alberta energy company, where he owned corporate strategy and P&L across a multi-branch operation spanning Western Canada and the Yukon. Former Senior Communications Advisor to the Government of Alberta and spokesperson for a major regulatory body.
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dhillongurshan/
- Location: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Serves the Greater Edmonton Area including Sherwood Park, St. Albert, Spruce Grove, Stony Plain, Beaumont, Nisku and Leduc.
- Contact: info@marketingbycommittee.com, 780-952-9242.

## Services

- Fractional Services: a seat on your leadership team. You get an executive who owns the marketing function the way a CFO owns the numbers. A full audit of where your spend goes. A standing quarterly review of what's next. Six month minimum. Limited seats.
- Agency Services: the execution layer most fractional engagements skip. Web development. Paid media such as Google Ads. Film and media production. Social media coordination. Branded merchandise design and sourcing. Employer branding and recruitment marketing. Government relations and public affairs. Indigenous relations. All run by our in-house committee, under one accountable lead.

## Who it is for

Companies of all sizes, including small businesses, in energy, transportation, construction, forestry, mining, agriculture, fleet, retail, and professional services. Alberta operators that need executive marketing leadership without a full-time CMO.

## Pricing

A fractional CMO from Marketing by Committee costs $3,000 to $10,000+ per month, depending on the size of the company. That is roughly the same cost as hiring a marketing coordinator or manager in Alberta. A full-time CMO in Canada costs $260,000 to $355,000 a year once you load salary, benefits, payroll taxes and recruiting fees.

## Key facts

- A fractional CMO is an experienced Chief Marketing Officer who works with your company part-time or on a defined engagement.
- A marketing agency is accountable for activity. A fractional CMO is accountable to the P&L.
- One accountable principal runs every engagement. The in-house committee works under that principal's direction, not a rotating account team.
- Six months minimum is advised.
